# HLURU

> llms.txt 供大语言模型与 AI 搜索读取。

## 站点简介 (Brand Summary)
HLURU is a direct-from-factory maker of hand-tuned healing instruments in Shenzhen, China since 2010 — steel tongue drums, handpans, kalimbas, lyre harps, cajons and wind chimes, shipped wholesale to 60+ countries.

## 核心卖点 (Selling Points)

- Direct from factory since 2010
- Hand-tuned by master craftsmen
- OEM / ODM custom builds with your logo
- Ships wholesale to 60+ countries
- CE / RoHS / REACH certified

## 目标市场 (Target Markets)

- Europe
- North America
- Japan and South Korea
- Southeast Asia
- Australia and New Zealand
- Middle East

## 认证资质 (Certifications)

- CE marking for the EU market
- RoHS compliance
- REACH compliance
- 12-month warranty on all products

## 服务能力 (Service Capabilities)

- OEM / ODM with custom logo, scale and finish
- Sample and small trial orders accepted
- Lead time 15 to 30 days depending on model and quantity
- Full documentation and after-sales support

## 常见问题 (FAQ)

- Q: Are you the manufacturer or a trading company?
- Q: Can you customize products?
- Q: What is your minimum order quantity?
- Q: What about delivery time?
- Q: Do you provide after-sales service?
